thresholds.label: GTIN coverage
thresholds.note: every sellable variant carries a valid GTIN

thresholds.label: Required attribute completeness
thresholds.note: category-required fields populated from the PIM

thresholds.label: Schema coverage on PDPs
thresholds.note: Product, Offer, rating and policy types present

thresholds.label: Feed freshness
thresholds.note: time from PIM change to feed pickup

thresholds.label: Price + availability accuracy
thresholds.note: what the agent reads vs what the site charges

thresholds.label: Factual density per PDP
thresholds.note: machine-readable spec attributes per product page

brandChips.label: No claim without a source field behind it
No superlatives an agent can restate as fact
Units and dimensions in the buyer’s locale
Tone: plain, specific, no marketing adjectives in specs
Comparisons cite the competitor’s published number or not at all

locked.label: Canonical product facts, single source
locked.detail: The PIM is the only source of truth. No channel-level attribute overrides — a fix goes in once and regenerates everywhere.

locked.label: Machine-readable policy requirement
locked.detail: Returns, shipping and warranty publish as structured data. Human-readable copy is generated from the same record, never written separately.

locked.label: No synthetic specifications
locked.detail: Nothing enters the catalogue that was inferred, scraped from a competitor or generated. Missing means missing.

locked.label: Price parity with the storefront
locked.detail: The feed price is the site price at read time. A stale price is pulled rather than published.

trigger.what: Scout ran the weekly 46-query battery across all four surfaces and logged every citation and recommendation.
Hero SKU citation count fell to 11 against competitor A’s 29 — a nine-point share drop in three weeks.
Steward traced four wrong-spec answers to a single stale attribute on the Walmart feed and pinned the card for a decision.

agents.name: Merchandiser
agents.role: Owns catalogue attributes, PDP content and the enrichment queue.

agents.name: Scout
agents.role: Runs the query battery and tracks competitor citations per surface.

agents.name: Steward
agents.role: Owns feed integrity, schema deploys and the mismatch log.

agents.name: Agentic Readiness Score
agents.role: Scores structured data, factual density, policy and accuracy.

agents.name: Answer-Surface Monitor
agents.role: Samples answers and diffs them against the canonical record.
